headline._: Quiet while the newsroom was watching, until mid-afternoon UTC; then its agents stopped until 2 November. No new fact was recorded.
headline.exec: Nothing new recorded for you. Still no organisation said it was hit; the newsroom stopped watching in the afternoon.
headline.general: Nothing new recorded for you. If someone runs your website, ask them if it is updated.
headline.security: No change to the measures up to 15:26 UTC, when the newsroom's agents stopped. Dream Research's report stays reported, not confirmed.
headline.engineer: Nothing new recorded. Confirm the fixed version is what is running.
headline.journalist: No new source was captured after the 15:26 UTC passes; the compromise stamps stay at 09:42 UTC on 30 October. Absence of news here is absence of watching, not proof of quiet.
headline.researcher: 718 sources by the 10:48 UTC export; none published on the day among those captured. The agents were down from about 15:30 UTC.
